title: 第11章 卑鄙是贵族的通行证第12章 收税但收的是别人家的村
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
这个世界处处充满血腥和卑鄙，人太好可容易暴毙，尤其是身为贵族，菲尔德已经没有耐心和善良，来和这个世界的混蛋们交流了。
还是让铁和血来发言吧！卑鄙，才是贵族的通行证。
事实证明，人类攻击同类，远比对付腐尸还要简单，至少同类长得不恐怖。
一个人类奴隶嚎了声，飞扑上去，按住断臂的士兵，用手里的镰刀狠狠凿进他的脖子，猛拽一下，直接将他的脑袋扯了下来，士兵惊恐的神情还凝固在脸上。
“干的很好，它是你的了。”菲尔德嘴角勾勒起弧度，从口袋中摸出一枚银币丢给他，“我允许奴隶拥有自己的财产，并且多劳多得！”
周围的奴隶眼睛都红了，一枚银币可不是小数目，可以买一百个黑面包，让他们的生命延续一百天！瞬间，他们被金钱激起了血性。
又因为有阿诗娜的巨狼带头冲锋，奴隶们无所畏惧，握紧武器一起冲杀上去。
“真是场轻松的屠杀。”
在神选者面前，数量过少的全甲步兵不过是笑话，穿着重甲的士兵被狼爪一拍就扁，鲜血从扁成“二次元”的尸体内流出，汩汩汇聚成河。
无视掉求饶河哀求，快速解决掉叛变的守军后，菲尔德踮起脚尖，避免沾染地上的残肢断臂，小心地进入了暗堡。
“这里是武器库！”
当菲尔德看到要塞的武器库时，再也无法掩饰惊喜的神情。
映入眼帘的是堆叠的如同小山一般的甲胄，散发着保养后的桐油香味，扎捆的整整齐齐，旁边架子则是放着制式的长戟、钢刀和包铁盾，弓弩则是挂在墙上，桶装的羽箭含括了各种功能。
能轻松将五百人武装到牙齿，而且披甲率能达到百分百。
一个男爵不可能养得起如此多的军备，这都是帝国各处运来的，每一年，各大领主都需要抽出一部分物资和金币，用来支持边境的建设，防止腐化怪物和兽人的入侵。
“咔山要塞光是作为前哨要塞，就有如此多物资，后面的几个巨型要塞，有多富我都不敢想。”
“我们，是不是发财了？”阿诗娜拿下一把骑弓，爱不释手。
“发了一笔小财，这才哪到哪。”菲尔德其实爽翻了，大手一挥，“还愣着干嘛，你们先武装起来。”
“好！”听到自己能装备上昂贵的防具，众人立刻上去解开绳子，一套套札甲往身上套，这些奴隶第一次感受到甲胄的力量，沉甸甸地，但安全感拉满。
唯一美中不足的，就是奴隶们太瘦小，穿上甲胄后晃晃悠悠的。

“嘿嘿，叫你恶心我，理查。”菲尔德搓搓手，叫来第一个动手的奴隶“你叫什么名字？”
“大人，我叫山猫。”山猫显得很紧张。
在知识被垄断的年代，底层人的名字一般都很随意。当然，想不随意也不行，要是碰瓷了贵族老爷，铡刀和马蹄可不和你开玩笑。
“我有个任务交给你，我们先演练两遍。”菲尔德将山猫叫到跟前，神神秘秘地连说带比画。
既然已经私吞了公牛男爵的武器装备，那也不在乎更过分一点。
让山猫带领二十人离开后，菲尔德琢磨起眼前的武器装备来。
“全带走，必须全带走，不然浑身难受。”菲尔德来回踱了几步，“阿诗娜，让卡奥带所有人过来，将装备从城墙上送下去，等我们过了关隘后再来捡，他们已经是夜幕领的装备。”
不够！光有武器装备，菲尔德无法满足，去夜幕领就是场豪赌，必须孤注一掷。
咔山要塞有全国的贵族供给，但其领下的村庄，半点税也不会少交。总共有六个大村庄，负责提供要塞供给，因为土地肥沃，每年都会源源不断向男爵城堡供给牛羊小麦和税金。
小山丘壑连绵，一队装备精良的士兵，扛着公牛男爵的家族旗帜，穿过枯藤杂草，以及断垣残壁。
牛角村，以两座高耸的哨塔闻名乡里，其实只有四米高，还是算上了顶盖，但依旧是村里的骄傲。这两座看似简陋的哨塔，只要站上了猎户，就能依托外围木墙和民兵，抵御强盗的袭击。
就在昨晚，他们还射杀了三只腐尸，据说是墙外漏进来的。
天呐，连要塞内都出现了怪物，这种情况让老人们想到了可怕的兽人。
三四个穿着麻衣的村民拿着粪叉，端着蔬菜汤坐在村口闲聊，讨论东村的寡妇能挺过绿皮兽人几回合，不时发出恶劣的狂笑声。
“是大人的士兵！”村民认出了旗帜，但不清楚士兵们的来意，大家都很茫然。
很快，山猫带着的奴隶卫兵出现在视野中。
“快开门。”山猫骂骂咧咧，身旁的士兵配合地将长戟往地上一杵，步兵札甲发出清脆的碰响声，山猫学着贵族的样子，趾高气昂地吼道，“你想让我们呆门外喝西北风吗？该死的蠢货。”
村民们猛地反应过来，连忙撅着腚迎众人进来。
“大人，是为了腐尸的事情吗？我们村抵御了腐尸的进攻，感谢神明，当然，也要感谢男爵大人，我们会献上幼女，保证男爵大人满意。”村长脸笑的和菊花一样灿烂，主动迎了上来，但看到山猫后，明显愣了一下，“这位长官，我似乎没见过你。”
山猫心里紧张，但想到菲尔德的交代，碰到不好回答的问题，直接骂人即可。

“叉你老母，你个毒蛇的狗腿子，哪里来那么多废话！”山猫直接拔刀，“我是来收税的，不是来认亲的，知道吗！我管你见没见过我！”
村长被喷了满脸口水，又被山猫的拔刀吓得差点滚翻在地“应该的大人，是我的错。”
“农税，人口税、家庭税、信仰税、土地税、免役税、呼吸税，还有啥玩意来着，你们懂的，我们公牛领常交的税收。”
中世纪的税收种类极为丰富，总有一款适合农民宝宝。
content_en:
This world is full of blood and despicability, and people who are too nice can easily die suddenly, especially as a noble, Field has no patience and kindness to communicate with the bastards in this world.
Let iron and blood speak for themselves! Being despicable is the hallmark of nobility.
Facts have proved that it is much easier for humans to attack the same kind than to deal with the rotting corpses, at least the same kind of people are not scary in appearance.
A human slave howled, rushed forward, held down the soldier who had lost his arm, dug into his neck with the sickle in his hand, yanked hard, and tore his head off. The soldier's frightened expression was still frozen on his face.
"Well done, it's yours." Field curled his lips, took out a silver coin from his pocket and threw it to him, "I allow slaves to own their own property, and the more they work, the more they will get!"
The eyes of the slaves around were red. One silver coin was not a small amount. It could buy a hundred pieces of black bread and extend their lives for a hundred days! In an instant, they were aroused by money.
And because Ashina's giant wolf took the lead in the charge, the slaves were fearless and grabbed their weapons and charged forward together.
"What an easy massacre."
In front of the God's Chosen One, the small number of fully armored infantry was nothing but a joke. Soldiers wearing heavy armor were flattened by wolf claws, and blood flowed from the corpses that were flattened into "two dimensions" and gurgled into a river.
Ignoring the begging for mercy and quickly getting rid of the mutinous defenders, Field stood on tiptoes to avoid contaminating the broken limbs on the ground, and carefully entered the bunker.
"This is the weapons arsenal!"
Field could no longer hide his surprise when he saw the fortress' arsenal.
What comes into view is a pile of armor that looks like a hill, exuding the scent of tung oil after maintenance, neatly bundled. On the shelf next to it are standard halberds, steel knives and iron-clad shields. Bows and crossbows are hung on the wall, and barreled arrows contain various functions.
It can easily arm five hundred people to the teeth, and the armor armor rate can reach 100%.
It is impossible for a baron to maintain such a large amount of armaments. These are all shipped from all over the empire. Every year, the major lords need to allocate part of the supplies and gold coins to support the construction of the border and prevent the invasion of corrupt monsters and orcs.
"Kashan Fortress, just as an outpost fortress, has so much supplies. I can't even imagine how rich the several giant fortresses behind it are."
"Are we getting rich?" Ashina took out a riding bow and couldn't put it down.
"I've made a small fortune, how can I get here now?" Field was actually very happy and waved his hand, "Why are you still standing there? Arm yourself first."
"Okay!" After hearing that they could be equipped with expensive armor, everyone immediately went up to untie the ropes and put a set of armor on their bodies. These slaves felt the power of the armor for the first time. It was heavy, but they felt full of security.
The only flaw is that the slaves are too thin and swaying after putting on the armor.
"Hey, you disgust me, Richard." Field rubbed his hands and called the first slave to make a move, "What's your name?"
"Sir, my name is Shanmao." Shanmao looked very nervous.
In an era when knowledge was monopolized, people at the bottom generally had random names. Of course, it doesn't matter if you don't want to be casual. If you mess with the noble master, the guillotine and horseshoe will not joke with you.
"I have a task for you. Let's practice it twice first." Field called Bobcat to him and spoke and gestured mysteriously.
Since he has already misappropriated Bull Baron's weapons and equipment, he doesn't mind going too far.
After letting Bobcat lead twenty people away, Field pondered the weapons and equipment in front of him.
"Take them all, you must take them all away, otherwise you will feel uncomfortable all over." Field took a few steps back and forth, "Ashina, ask Kaa to bring everyone over and send the equipment down the city wall. We will pick it up after we pass the pass. They are already the equipment of the Night Leader."
Noenough! Field couldn't be satisfied with weapons and equipment alone. Going to the Night Territory was a big gamble and he had to make a desperate move.
Kashan Fortress is supplied by nobles from all over the country, but the villages under its leadership will not pay any less taxes. There are six large villages in total, which are responsible for providing supplies to the fortress. Because the land is fertile, cattle, sheep, wheat and taxes are continuously supplied to the baron's castle every year.
A group of well-equipped soldiers, carrying the Bull Baron's family flag, passed through dead vines, weeds, and broken walls.
Niujiao Village is famous for its two towering sentry towers. In fact, they are only four meters high, and they still count as the top, but they are still the pride of the village. These two seemingly simple sentry towers, as long as they stand on the Orions, can rely on the outer wooden walls and militia to resist the attacks of bandits.
Just last night, they shot three wights, which they said had leaked in from outside the wall.
God, even monsters appeared in the fortress. This situation reminded the old people of the terrifying orcs.
Three or four villagers in sackcloth were sitting at the entrance of the village with dung forks and vegetable soup, discussing how many rounds the widow in the East Village could survive the green-skinned orcs, and they laughed wildly from time to time.
"They are your Excellency's soldiers!" The villagers recognized the flag, but did not know the purpose of the soldiers, and everyone was at a loss.
Soon, the slave guards led by Bobcat appeared in sight.
"Open the door quickly." Shanmao cursed, and the soldiers beside him slammed their halberds on the ground in coordination. The infantry armor made a clear clanking sound. Shanmao imitated the nobles and shouted arrogantly, "Do you want us to stay outside and drink the northwest wind? Damn idiots."
The villagers reacted suddenly and hurriedly raised their butts to welcome everyone in.
"Sir, is it about the rotting corpse? Our village has resisted the attack of the rotting corpse. Thank you to the gods. Of course, we must also thank the Baron. We will offer our young daughter to ensure that the Baron is satisfied." The village chief's smile was as bright as a chrysanthemum and he took the initiative to greet him. However, when he saw the lynx, he was obviously stunned. "Sir, I seem to have never seen you before."
Shanmao was nervous, but thinking about Field's instructions, if you encounter questions that are difficult to answer, just curse them.
"Assass your mother, you venomous bitch, where did all the nonsense come from!" Shanmao drew his knife directly, "I'm here to collect taxes, not to recognize my relatives, you know that! I don't care whether you have seen me or not!"
The village chief was sprayed with saliva all over his face, and was so frightened by Shanmao's sword that he almost rolled to the ground. "That's right, sir, it's my fault."
"Agricultural tax, population tax, family tax, faith tax, land tax, exemption tax, breathing tax, and other things. You know, we bulls pay taxes all the time."
There are many types of taxes in the Middle Ages, and there is always one suitable for peasant babies.
